title: GitHub issue triage workflow: label-less issues get labels from title prefixes [BUG]/[SETUP-BUG]/[FR]/[DOC-FIX] in triage.yml
answers: Why did my newly opened issue with a [BUG] title get the bug label automatically?
How do I add a new title prefix so issues get a label when they are filed?
Where is the automatic labeling of issues based on title prefix handled?
Why was a new issue with labels already set left alone by the triage bot?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/triage.yml (job `label`, triggered on `issues: opened`) handles newly opened GitHub issues that have no labels at all; it maps a leading title prefix to labels via `gh issue edit --add-label`. It uses no LLM or external service.
Rule: Keep this workflow title-only and label-gated: the job `if` checks `github.event.issue.labels[0] == null`, so it only runs for issues with zero labels. Prefix matching strips leading whitespace with `${TITLE#...}` and uppercases with `${title^^}` before a quoted `case` pattern, which makes matching case-insensitive; unmatched titles hit `*)` and exit 0 without changes. To add a prefix, add a `case` arm and its labels; keep the `"[PREFIX]"*` quoting so brackets match literally.
Constraints: Applies only to issues opened with no labels; issues filed through issue forms or already labeled are skipped. Labels are added, never removed, and existing labels are not inspected beyond the first slot. Edits to the `case` arms must keep uppercase patterns because the title is uppercased before matching.
applies: Repository GitHub Actions automation for issue labeling in mlflow/mlflow; not for PR labeling or for issues that already carry labels.
says: Automatically assign category labels to newly opened tickets based on their title prefix.
Issues submitted with preselected tags do not receive automatic labels from title prefixes.
Add automated label assignment for new feature requests starting with bracketed prefixes.
Forms that preassign tags prevent the triage automation from adding title labels.
search: GitHub issue triage automation in .github/workflows/triage.yml labels newly opened, label-less issues by matching title prefixes using gh issue edit --add-label. The label job runs on issues: opened only when github.event.issue.labels[0] is null, stripping leading whitespace and uppercasing titles before matching quoted uppercase case patterns like "[PREFIX]"*. Applies only to issue labeling in mlflow/mlflow; issues filed through forms or already carrying labels are skipped, labels are never removed, and it does not apply to pull requests.
